subject: End CODE-SELECTED-INFO-20261005: stable status label and exact hashes
body:
# CODE-SELECTED-INFO-20261005: stable

Scrum authorised MapViewport.jsx, the selected status component/helper, focused tests and own replay QA. Existing narrow claim retained across the usage-limit interruption. Master, mailbox and final-build lock rechecked on continuation: no conflicting active integration window. Claude begin notice1791212944459-a24965e6306a. No renderer.js, art, core, generator, planner, bank or shared HTML changes. The final shared build remains Claude-owned.

## Result

Selected-hero name, health, AP and holding/exhausted status now render in a constant screen-size label with a leader to the hero's actual ground centre. A full160x58 label is preferred; a90x40 two-line label fits the crowded phone guide slot. The compact text is `14 ♥ 0 AP Hold`; its accessible label retains `Cobweb: 14 health, 0 AP; Holding Platform brace`. Actual text bounds74.03px fit within the90px panel. Figures, world positions, source alpha, logical hex polygons and all actions remain unchanged. The label ignores pointer events, so the map receives input normally.

Placement searches anchor-relative positions and obstacle edges, avoiding measured camera/Goal/Find/offscreen/guide/minimap controls, active station/pan information and the actual visible sprite bounds, including foreground enemies. It follows camera movement and refocus; it hides when the ground anchor is outside the viewport. It is drawn above figures and other map labels. The selected hero's old world-size name/health/holding labels are replaced; unselected heroes retain their existing labels. The existing centre-based zoom, Lock semantics and resize-preservation helper are unchanged.

## Evidence

Own fixture copies only the actual saved browser-record prefixes: Unequal Crossing T3 seed2 at command23 for held Cobweb and command13 for AP0 Amberly. It replays those commands through the real reducer, saves through the normal persistence API and mounts the real private route with eudaimon+Rooke. Own keys start `orchard-code-selected-info-20261005`; another worker's saves, records, certificates and rewards were not changed. This is explicitly labelled saved-state replay QA, not a new playthrough or win.

Final42measurements pass independent verification:

- Held Cobweb14health/0AP and exhausted Amberly16health/0AP on phone390x844, tablet768x1024 and desktop1280x800 at minimum0.45, native1 and maximum2:18views.
- Phone guide remains open at all three zoom levels:3views. The compact label has zero overlap with the reserved controls and visible figure bounds, including the original Cobweb/foreground-enemy problem.
- Select Barrow, inspect unchanged unselected Cobweb labels, pan, refocus, Move, keyboard destination preview and Cancel on all three sizes:21views. Every label has zero measured HUD overlap and zero placement overlap with the visible figure bounds. Exactly one selected label is present.
- All42trace/progress pairs remain byte-identical within each real saved prefix. Their command counts remain23or13, replay hashes match, every shown health/AP/holding value matches the independently replayed state and all heroes' DOM ground centres match their real axial positions. No paid action was confirmed. The camera remains scale2 and preserves the world point at the viewport centre through Move, preview and Cancel on all three sizes.

Thirteen focused tests pass, including actual held/AP0 prefix component rendering with unchanged state hashes, free-space placement, crowded guide compact placement, offscreen hiding, short-height compact rendering and the existing camera/private-gate tests. A placement test initially assumed enough space for a full label when its synthetic obstacles covered the entire slot; the compact variant and real guide case are now explicitly tested. The final small-height branch correction does not alter any of the42captured viewport cases; a fresh final-preview phone maximum capture also verifies the rebuilt executable.

Artifacts: selected-info-stable-measurements.json, selected-info-stable-checkpoint.json, selected-info-tests.txt and42`selected-info-stable-*.png` captures. Cases are associated with their PNG names in capture order; the `label` field is the actual accessible status text, with separate `caseId` metadata. Final isolated preview14192322bytes; no WallabyMaths.html or www/index.html rebuild. Representative final phone/guide, tablet AP0 and desktop/foreground views visually inspected. Earlier unsuccessful full/110px guide attempts remain separate and are not included in the stable checkpoint. Viewport override reset after verification.

- ui.test.js unchanged from camera window:ecb55d0f0de3154a561b7e0ae40340467610d8c86b928a0e128e8332c21a2d31

## Limits

This verifies selected information for the named genuine saved states, not every possible obstacle arrangement. If a viewport is entirely covered by overlays, placement chooses the least obstructed available rectangle. Unselected world labels and foreground sprite occlusion are otherwise unchanged. Confirmation dialogs deliberately sit in front of the map and show the exact AP cost; their presence is not treated as a map-label placement failure. Physical touch/pinch, Android, child playtesting, final integrated/offline App acceptance and whole Orchard completion are unverified. Browser win coverage remains23/25unique family tiers; no LR work or paid-service retries.
